definitions.explanation: Of paints, inks, and similar products: using water as the solvent, as opposed to oil.

examples.japanese: {水性|すいせい}⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write with a water-based pen.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水性|すいせい}です。

{水性|すいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧におい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧、⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧。
examples.english: Water-based paint has little smell and is easy to use indoors.

notes:
Used directly before a noun ({水性|すいせい}⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧) or with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水性|すいせい}⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧: water-based pen
- {水性塗料|すいせいとりょう}: water-based paint
- {水性|すいせい}⟦マーカー→マーカー：21828_maakaa⟧: water-based marker

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{油性|ゆせい}→油性：24068_yusei⟧: oil-based; permanent (⟦{油性|ゆせい}ペン→油性ペン：19744_yuseipen⟧, permanent marker)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{水星|すいせい}→水星：18165_suisei⟧ (Mercury) and ⟦{彗星|すいせい}→彗星：05053_suisei⟧ (comet) have the same reading.
